claim_one_line: THE GROUNDING: three artefacts that replace memory with a lookup, built to the owner-s directive after the consolidation. (1) docs/COMPUTE_THE_PROGRAM.md DEFINES THE TERM -- compute the entire program means COMPUTE OVER THE OBJECT AS FULL RELATIONS, NEVER AS A SINGLE MANIFOLD; it is a QUANTIFIER INSTRUCTION, not run-everything -- with the standing inventory of what full relations means (member, two ends, CLASS via B803 where the trace field is a commensurability invariant so the class/member gap is STRUCTURAL, sisters m003 at index 12 beyond the index-6 horizon most arcs used, BOTH ROWS golden/silver non-commensurable being the only true genericity control, the child as a filling with arithmetic not inherited, eleven faces plus the twelfth, and the A1-A7 axioms = aAbB), plus the pre-compute protocol P0-P6 of which P0 catches the most (state the quantifier in one sentence BEFORE computing) and cc3-s mechanically checkable rule that A CLOSURE SURVIVES THE RELATIONAL RE-READ EXACTLY WHEN ITS SCOPE SENTENCE NAMES NO MANIFOLD. (2) docs/THE_LADDER.md maps THE NEGATIVES AS RUNGS -- 30 of them graded BLIND (never asked, so saying absent is unearned), HOLE (a gap inside something already claimed), BROKEN (claimed and does not hold), BOUNDED (a theorem with a named mechanism, an edge not a gap) and OPEN (a live runnable surface) -- with binding rules that a rung moves only with a banked arc, that BLIND never becomes BOUNDED in one step but must pass through OPEN because something has to be COMPUTED before an edge can be claimed, and that BROKEN outranks new frontiers because a broken claim actively misleads. (3) WORKING_RULES.md section 0 makes it BINDING FOR EVERY SEAT rather than optional. THE RULE THAT DOES THE WORK: before writing the object does not supply X, find X on the ladder; if X is not there it has NOT BEEN CHECKED and the honest sentence is NOT CHECKED, not ABSENT -- which converts we-do-not-have-X from an impression into A CLAIM WITH A CITATION, the same standard already applied to positives, and finally gives the corpus-s own rule (an unearned negative costs as much as an overclaim) an instrument. THE PROBLEM AS DATA: on 2026-08-08 this seat declared open or absent FIVE TIMES something the repo held (B950 Z6/B862, B976 hypercharge/B864, B974 the frame/B911, B979 A7 in section 5 of the file being read, B981 the spherical end in the second clause of the sentence being quoted); it is NOT personal, since cc3-s relational re-read committed the same error INSIDE THE AUDIT BUILT TO CATCH IT and B982 found it INSIDE A GOVERNANCE GATE. It is what happens when a 949-arc corpus is queried from memory. SCOPE HONESTLY: this is GOVERNANCE, NOT MATHEMATICS -- it proves nothing about the object; and the ladder-s 30 rungs are a SNAPSHOT NOT A THEOREM, its BLIND grades being claims about the repo-s COVERAGE measured by marker scan and reading, which cc3-s own recall control (49% on known pairs) says under-counts -- so a rung graded BLIND may yet have an arc nobody found, which is exactly why the grade means NOT CHECKED and never ABSENT.
